findings.reason: a reader or node entering the plan is told the cause is a field error the plan has already closed negative, and the work that remains (§7's compensator image, §9's coil-correction re-solve, §11's seed-current re-registration) is solver-side and current-registration work, so the wrong framing mis-orients every downstream read of the sections that are still open.
findings.text: the lede asserts "The leading mechanism is the external field … so a few-percent field error is amplified into exactly this kind of whole-plasma vertical excursion", but §2 (:42-44) records "Closed negative for the missing-field hypothesis: the tared residual named no missing physical source", the f-dvf-004 outcome (:146-148) reads the metre-scale axis motion as "a solver-side branch or vertical-mode result", and the `plan-summary` rewritten this round (:10) now names finite-edge profiles, one coupling kernel and conductor currents instead — so the plan's introduction states the mechanism its own body refutes and that its own introduction's summary itself names

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — every cited fragment (edge-current refusal, inactive-compensator recovery, external-current propagation, xpoint profile extent, coil correction, pinned seed drift, finite edge flux) resolves under `docs/evidence/fragments/diiid-vertical-force-balance/`; §7's and §12's record paths are declared deliverables rather than existing citations, and §12 states at :113 that its named paths were never written.
rubric_items.done_when: pass — the three remaining implementable sections (§7, §9, §11) each carry a falsifiable measure: §7's masked-vs-unmasked null comparison with a negative control that restores the term, §9's fitted-vs-measured current-vector equality with two controls, and §11's replay that must restore the registration to 1.3e-7.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — §7 names `docs/evidence/fragments/diiid-vertical-force-balance/diiid-inactive-compensator-finite-edge.html` and its figure directory, §13's declared record and figures exist on disk, and no gate writes to a session scratchpad or node-local temporary path.
rubric_items.naming: pass — no plan labels, stage names, ticket numbers or version tags reach any symbol or comment; the section names that remain are descriptive of what they measure.
rubric_items.reasoning: a finding — the lede at :37 still names the external field as the leading mechanism and attributes the metre-scale displacement to it, while the plan's own §2 landed the missing-field hypothesis closed negative and the f-dvf-004 outcome reads the axis motion as solver-side, and this round's rewritten `plan-summary` (:10) has dropped that framing, leaving the document contradicting itself.
